findings.title: Lithuanian TOTP instruction was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The `totpStep1` value in the Lithuanian account message bundle is now Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare"). Lithuanian users of the account console will see an unrelated-language instruction when configuring TOTP; replace it with a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Lithuanian login TOTP instruction was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The `loginTotpStep1` value in the Lithuanian login message bundle is now Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare"). This makes the TOTP setup flow display an Italian instruction for the Lithuanian locale; it needs a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle now contains a Traditional Chinese TOTP instruction
findings.body: The `totpStep1` value in the `zh_CN` bundle uses Traditional Chinese characters (for example, `手機`, `應用程式`, and `以下`). Users selecting Simplified Chinese will receive a mixed-script account UI; this string should be translated in Simplified Chinese.
